Ten functions and methods in `django/` call `constant_time_compare` directly. I grepped for every use of the name and found each call's enclosing function. No module imports it under another name or calls it as `crypto.constant_time_compare`, so the grep caught every call.

- **`django/middleware/csrf.py`:** `_does_token_match` (line 157).
- **`django/core/signing.py`:** `Signer.unsign` (line 211).
- **`django/contrib/auth/hashers.py`:** the `verify` methods of four hashers:
  - `PBKDF2PasswordHasher.verify` (344)
  - `BCryptSHA256PasswordHasher.verify` (527)
  - `ScryptPasswordHasher.verify` (622)
  - `MD5PasswordHasher.verify` (673)

  The subclasses `PBKDF2SHA1PasswordHasher` and `BCryptPasswordHasher` reuse their parent's `verify` and don't call it themselves. `Argon2PasswordHasher` doesn't call it either.
- **`django/contrib/auth/tokens.py`:** `PasswordResetTokenGenerator.check_token` (line 70).
- **`django/contrib/auth/__init__.py`:** `login` (line 117) and `get_user` (lines 224 and 232).
